purpose: Request a separate, owner-authorized AURA-side review and staged adoption of the independently qualified Math exact-quantity packages; this draft is not evidence of any AURA migration.

artifact_availability.note: These hashes describe the exact observed RS025 local packages; the AURA agent must pin the SHA of the actual transferred feed artifact and verify identity, not assume rebuilding yields the same bytes.

requested_actions: Independently inspect AURA's current repository revision and compare relevant selected-source hashes to the pinned Math transfer baseline; enumerate drift before proposing a cutover.
Obtain the authorized three NuGet artifacts from an approved feed or owner-controlled transfer, record PackageId/version/SHA-256 and validate nuspec dependency and net10.0 assembly graph.
Enumerate actual current transitive call sites and tests in core math actions, nutrition, data transformations, SQLite, JSON, kernel and worker/CLI before any edit.

On an AURA-owned branch, adapt only pure-math references and facade calls; keep localization, culture resolution, command errors, permissions, worker policies, configuration and data contracts owned by AURA.

Qualify exact independent oracles: 1/3+1/6=1/2, 1 inch=127/5000 m, 1 KiB=1024 B, 32°F=0°C, rational versus irrational roots, temperature intervals, explicit US/UK/AU cup/pint assumptions, checked exponents and parser bounds.
Assess and obtain owner decisions for any inherited behavior divergence, notably historical culture-priority unit selection versus explicit Math profiles, before changing public behavior.

Run and record current AURA pure-math, core action, nutrition, data-transform, SQLite, JSON, kernel, worker/CLI and affected end-to-end tests; include failures and exclusions rather than fabricating coverage.
Retain prior AURA sources/references and rollback instructions until package use, public contracts, data effects and CLI behavior are independently verified.

Return a structured AURA-side acknowledgement with reviewed commit, package hashes, consumer diffs, passing/failing tests, outstanding divergences, rollback receipt and adoption state; do not remove duplicate sources until verified.
non_goals: No AURA, Decision or MCDM repository change is authorized from Math.
No automatic package publication, reference cutover, source deletion, data migration or private build artifact upload.
No assumption that a Math release gate is evidence of external consumer adoption.
No change to AURA permissions, localization, worker configuration or stable command/error contracts without explicit owner-side review.

rollback.prerequisite: Record the full pre-adoption AURA commit and previous package/source references before changes.
rollback.trigger: Any failed numerical, compatibility, privacy, data, CLI, packaging or worker regression, or any unapproved behavior divergence.
rollback.procedure: Restore previous AURA references and source/facade wiring on an AURA-owned branch, invalidate any changed package caches and rerun the impacted consumer and CLI regression matrix.
rollback.verification: Produce the restored AURA commit and tests; Math never applies the rollback itself.

expected_response.external_verified_only_if: Recipient's own durable reference and test evidence establish verified adoption.
